code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (very low arterial pH and oxygen saturation), mild leukopenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated ferritin, creatinine, monocytes, basophils, and CRP. These findings suggest acute severe respiratory failure with metabolic derangement, possible infection or inflammation, and early renal impairment. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
